span.p:
POST /api/land-distribution/optimize
area, N units, water W, objective, candidates (≤ 6)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
build_problem: unit area u = area / N
wᵢ = water/m² × u (FAO-56 seasonal or user value)
pᵢ = yield × u (× price) · minᵢ, maxᵢ from areas / targets

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
infeasibility_reason()?
minimums vs land / water,
target vs upper bound

div.style: color: rgb(124, 45, 18) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(15, 61, 46) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(15, 61, 46) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center; width: 400px;

span.p:
Actions: nᵢ ∈ [minᵢ, maxᵢ] keeping land ≤ N and water ≤ W
after reserving later crops' minimums

div.style: color: rgb(15, 61, 46) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p: Transition: append nᵢ, units += nᵢ, water += nᵢ·wᵢ

div.style: color: rgb(15, 61, 46) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p: Goal: i = m (+ production ≥ target for min_water)

div.style: color: rgb(15, 61, 46) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Step cost: nᵢ(p_max − pᵢ) + fallow·p_max at goal
(min_water: nᵢ·wᵢ)

div.style: color: rgb(15, 61, 46) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
h(s) = U·p_max − UB(s), UB = min(land-relaxed,
water-relaxed) fractional knapsack — admissible

span.p:
Also run the requested baselines on the same problem:
UCS (f = g), Greedy (f = h), BFS (FIFO, early goal test)
→ comparison table (nodes, frontier, cost, runtime)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

Response: status, allocation (units, m², L, kg),
totals, binding constraints, formulation, comparison,
'Optimal under the selected objective and constraints.'
